{{Quote|&hellip; each successive Sith Lord improved on it, Tenebrous and his Master most of all, though they wasted years attempting to create a targeted virus that could be deployed against the Jedi, separating them from the Force.|Darth Plagueis discusses the Sith Master's and Tenebrous's role in advancing the Grand Plan|<ref name="DP" />}}
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] reigned as the '''Sith Master''' of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] during the final [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The duo followed the [[Order of the Sith Lords|lineage]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], adhering to his [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], which restricted the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to one [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and one [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. During the Master's reign, the Twi'lek opened a [[Wound in the Force/Legends|hole]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], allowing the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to feel the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] for the first [[Time/Legends|time]] in over eight centuries after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|final battle]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. Eventually, the Twi'lek was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Tenebrous, who carried the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Sith imperative]] forward by taking the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] as his apprentice, dubbing him [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis.

==Biography==
[[File:DarthTenebrousHS-SWI130.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Sith Master trained Darth Tenebrous in the Sith ways.]]
In the final [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TTW" /> a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="DP" /> who was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] joined the [[Order of the Sith Lords]], eventually ascending to the rank of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. In keeping with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], which limited the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], the Twi'lek Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] eventually took the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Rugess Nome]] as a pupil, naming him [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tenebrous. The Twi'lek Sith Master and Tenebrous were dedicated to advancing the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]], which was a Sith imperative focused on destroying the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic. The pair worked for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to develop a [[virus]] that would target and sever a Jedi's connection to the Force. However, the Master and Tenebrous ultimately abandoned the project. At some point during the Sith Master's reign, the Twi'lek opened a [[Wound in the Force/Legends|rift in the Force]], allowing the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to sense the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] for the first [[Time/Legends|time]] in the eight centuries since the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|final battle]] of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="DP" />

[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tenebrous's Sith Master burdened the Bith with studying the Force, which Tenebrous viewed as simple. The Bith eventually came to believe that the Force was an energy source that he could manipulate in order to achieve his goals. After reading the prophecies in the [[Journal of the Whills/Legends|Journal of the Whills]] regarding the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] who would bring balance to the Force, Tenebrous was determined to use a variation of the [[Dark transfer|essence transfer]]&mdash;a [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] that enabled its user to transfer their consciousness into another body&mdash;at the moment of the [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|individual's]] [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]], thus making himself the Chosen One.<ref name="TTW" /> Between approximately [[167 BBY]] and approximately [[124 BBY]]<ref name="Note 1" /> when Tenebrous's calculations for his scheme were complete, the Twi'lek was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the apprentice, who went on to take the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] as his apprentice, naming him Darth Plagueis.<ref name="TTW" />

Plagueis, the Sith Master's eventual successor, acknowledged the Twi'lek's role in advancing the Grand Plan to topple the Jedi and the Republic and opening a rift in the Force. The Muun Sith Lord recounted the Master's and Tenebrous's achievements to his apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="DP" />

==Personality and traits==
The Twi'lek Sith Master was dedicated to the Sith initiative to topple the Jedi and the Republic. Despite the Master's and Tenebrous's attempts to create a virus that would separate the Jedi from the Force, they ultimately abandoned their efforts.<ref name="DP" /> Tenebrous viewed his Master as simplistic and tottering.<ref name="TTW" />

==Powers and abilities==
Tenebrous's Master was capable enough to cause a rift in the Force that enabled the Jedi Order to feel the dark side's presence for the first time since the New Sith Wars' final battle. However, the Twi'lek was not able to withstand Tenebrous, who slew his Master.<ref name="TTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Tenebrous's Sith Master was first mentioned in the short story ''[[The Tenebrous Way]]'', which was written by [[Matthew Stover]] for [[Star Wars Insider 130|''Star Wars Insider'' 130]] and released in [[December]] [[2011]].<ref name="TTW" /> The Sith Master was later mentioned in the novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], which was written by [[James Luceno]] and published on [[January 10]], [[2012]]. Tenebrous's Master's [[Species/Legends|species]] was established as a Twi'lek in the novel.<ref name="DP" />
